faqs: How do I book a trip?

Choose a trip, then send us your travel dates and the number of travellers on WhatsApp (+20 109 661 1124) or by email (info@booknilecruises.net). You can use the form on any trip page to prepare the message. We confirm availability and reply with the details.
Are the prices per person?
Yes. Trip prices on this site are per person in US dollars, shown as a starting price. Transfers are priced per car.
What is included in the price?

Every trip page has an "Included" and a "Not included" list. On most Nile cruises the price includes full-board accommodation on the ship, guided visits and transfers, while entrance fees, international flights, drinks and tips are not included.
Are entrance fees included?
In most trips they are not. Check the "Not included" list on the trip page, or ask us for the current entrance fees for your itinerary.
How long is a Nile cruise between Luxor and Aswan?
Most ships sail 4 days / 3 nights from Aswan to Luxor, or 5 days / 4 nights from Luxor to Aswan. Dahabiyas usually take 4 to 7 days because they stop at smaller sites. See all Nile cruises.
What is the difference between a cruise ship and a dahabiya?

A dahabiya is a small sailing boat with a handful of cabins. It moors at quieter places and feels like a private yacht. Cruise ships are larger, with a pool, more facilities and more guests. See dahabiya cruises.
Where does a Lake Nasser cruise go?
Between Aswan and Abu Simbel on Lake Nasser, visiting Nubian temples that the Nile ships cannot reach. See Lake Nasser cruises.
Can I add optional tours?
Yes. Popular additions are the hot air balloon ride in Luxor, the Nubian village in Aswan and Abu Simbel.
Can you arrange airport transfers?
Yes. We run private transfers in Luxor, Aswan, Abu Simbel and Hurghada. See the transfer prices.
What should I pack?
Comfortable walking shoes, sunscreen, a hat, light clothing, and a jacket for cooler evenings, especially in winter.
